Field notes · Reading

Reading without losing your place

A small detour can answer a question without becoming a whole new task.

Follow the reference

A useful link adds context: a definition, an example, or the original source. Read what you need, then return to the thought that brought you there.

Keep the reference close and the note within reach.

Keep what matters

Some pages deserve a longer visit. Keep those open while you take notes, compare ideas, or finish a draft. The rest can be a brief stop along the way.
